name: Legora
oneLiner: 面向律所的 AI 法律平台：Agent 起草修改 Word 文档、批量审阅合同（Tabular Review），并协调律师、客户与其他 Agent 的工作
oneLinerEn: AI platform for law firms whose agent drafts and edits Word documents, reviews thousands of contracts at once with Tabular Review, and coordinates work between lawyers, clients and other agents.
